request_context.objective: Design, provision, and deploy an end-to-end Microsoft Fabric Medallion data platform for Retail Omnichannel Sales and Fulfillment. Ingest operational PostgreSQL tables from schema 'retail_ops', enforce Bronze Delta raw landing, Silver cleansing with SHA-256 PII protection, Gold Kimball Star Schema Data Warehouse with business KPIs, Power BI Direct Lake semantic model, and a Master Data Factory pipeline orchestrator.

project_summary.business_objective: Consolidate in-store and e-commerce transactions, inventory snapshots, carrier fulfillment logistics, and customer master records into a unified Microsoft Fabric OneLake platform for real-time executive KPI reporting.

platform_summary.primary_engine: Microsoft Fabric Spark (Delta Lake) & T-SQL Warehouse

solution_summary.target_architecture: Microsoft Fabric Medallion Architecture (PostgreSQL Source 'retail_ops' -> 01 Raw Bronze Lakehouse -> 02 Stage Curation Notebook -> 03 Silver Harmonized Lakehouse -> 04 Gold Kimball Star Schema Warehouse -> Direct Lake Power BI Semantic Model -> Master Orchestrator Pipeline)
engineering_best_practices: Master Pipeline Orchestration: Deploy a top-level Data Factory pipeline ('pl_retail_medallion_master') coordinating sequential wave execution: Bronze ingestion -> Silver curation -> Gold Kimball dimensional load -> Data quality reconciliation -> Direct Lake refresh.
Bronze Layer (01 Raw): Immutable landing in 'lh_retail_bronze' with raw source fidelity preserved, augmented with audit metadata (_ingested_at, _source_schema, _batch_run_id).

Dual Ingestion Strategy: High-watermark CDC extraction on updated_at/order_date for transactional tables (orders, order_items, shipments, inventory_snapshots); full snapshot refresh for master dimensions (customers, products, stores, product_categories).
Security & Privacy: Apply deterministic salted SHA-256 masking to all sensitive customer PII fields (email, phone, street_address, first_name, last_name) before Silver promotion.

Silver Layer (03 Silver): Harmonized 'lh_retail_silver' enforcing Delta Lake ACID MERGE INTO upserts on primary keys, windowed ROW_NUMBER() deduplication, null-key quarantine routing, and decimal casting for financial attributes.

Gold Layer (04 Gold): Kimball Star Schema warehouse 'wh_retail_gold' with conformed surrogate keys (_sk), SCD Type 2 history tracking, and partitioned fact tables for sub-second Direct Lake Power BI queries.
Data Quality Gates: Great Expectations profiling suite verifying zero orphan records, non-negative monetary amounts, and referential integrity across the Star Schema.
expected_deliverables: pl_retail_bronze_ingest (DataPipeline in 01 Raw executing PostgreSQL copy activity)
nb_retail_curate_silver (PySpark Notebook in 02 Stage with Delta MERGE and SHA-256 PII masking)
wh_retail_gold (Warehouse in 04 Gold with Kimball Star Schema DDL)
sm_retail_direct_lake (Direct Lake Semantic Model with Executive KPIs)
nb_retail_quality_suite (PySpark Notebook in 02 Stage validating Great Expectations)
pl_retail_medallion_master (Master DataPipeline in 01 Raw orchestrating the complete end-to-end DAG)

business_entities.business_description: Master customer entity with loyalty tier, contact attributes, and commercial segmentation.
Catalog merchandise items with SKUs, brands, cost bases, and retail unit prices.
Physical stores (flagship, outlet) and digital online fulfillment channels.
Sales order headers capturing timestamps, customer references, payment methods, and totals.
Granular order line items with quantities, discounts, line totals, and profit margins.
Carrier fulfillment logistics, tracking numbers, shipping costs, and delivery performance.
Daily store-level product stock positions, quantities on hand, and reorder triggers.

dimensions.description: Enterprise calendar dimension with year, quarter, month, day, fiscal periods, and weekend indicators.
SCD Type 2 customer dimension with SHA-256 masked PII and loyalty categorization.
Conformed product dimension denormalized with product categories and merchandise departments.
Channel dimension distinguishing online web storefronts from brick-and-mortar retail locations.

facts.grain: One record per individual order line item
One record per order fulfillment shipment

executive_kpis.business_definition: Total monetary volume of customer retail purchases before discounts and deductions.
Net recognized sales revenue after applying promotional discounts.
executive_kpis.dax_measure: Net Sales Revenue = SUMX(fact_sales_orders, fact_sales_orders[line_total] * (1 - fact_sales_orders[discount_rate]))

executive_kpis.business_definition: Overall commercial profitability percentage after deducting product cost of goods sold.
Average transaction revenue generated per unique customer purchase order.
Percentage of shipments delivered to customer within the promised delivery window.
Proportion of total revenue generated by Online Direct vs. Physical Stores.
executive_kpis.formula: CALCULATE([Net Sales Revenue], dim_store[channel_type] = 'online') / [Net Sales Revenue]
executive_kpis.dax_measure: Online Revenue % = DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales Revenue], dim_store[channel_type] = "online"), [Net Sales Revenue], 0) * 100

executive_kpis.business_definition: Number of product SKUs whose on-hand inventory has dropped below the safety reorder point.

master_orchestrator_specification.description: End-to-end master Data Factory DAG orchestrating ingestion, curation, dimensional modeling, and semantic model refresh.

dag_execution_waves.name: Bronze Raw Ingestion
dag_execution_waves.description: Extracts tables from PostgreSQL schema 'retail_ops' into Bronze Lakehouse 'lh_retail_bronze'.

dag_execution_waves.name: Silver Delta Curation
dag_execution_waves.description: Deduplicates records, applies SHA-256 PII masking, and executes Delta MERGE INTO 'lh_retail_silver'.

dag_execution_waves.name: Gold Kimball Warehouse Build
dag_execution_waves.description: Constructs Kimball Dimensions (dim_customer, dim_product, dim_store, dim_date) and Facts (fact_sales_orders, fact_order_fulfillment, fact_inventory_daily) in 'wh_retail_gold'.

dag_execution_waves.name: Data Quality Gates
dag_execution_waves.description: Executes Great Expectations assertions for schema validity, primary key uniqueness, and monetary constraints.

dag_execution_waves.name: Direct Lake Semantic Model Refresh
dag_execution_waves.description: Refreshes Power BI Direct Lake model metadata for sub-second report interactivity.
